root_cause_name: No registration velocity control at enrolment
fix: Cap enrolments per device and per IP, and hold a cluster that registered together out of payout eligibility until it has been verified separately.

root_cause_name: No throttle or breached-credential screening on the login endpoint
fix: Rate-limit per IP and per account, lock out on sustained failure, and screen candidate passwords against known-breach corpora before accepting them (NIST SP 800-63B).
Promote a successful login on an unseen device to a step-up challenge before the session is granted full privileges; treat the resulting session as limited until the challenge clears.
Invalidate every active session and refresh token on credential change, and force re-authentication before any payout in the window after a reset completes.
Re-verify an account that has been idle beyond a set threshold before it can transact; an idle account is exactly what a bought credential list is for.

root_cause_name: Instant payout in a high-conversion category
fix: Place a hold on gift-card, jewelry and digital-goods value until the account's device and reset state has aged out of the takeover window.

root_cause_name: Confirmed account did not trigger its device neighbourhood
fix: When one account on a shared device is confirmed fraudulent, re-score and review every account on that device and IP in the same case, not one at a time.
